sections.title: How this item benefits the environment
sections.html: Improving grazing management means there will be less damage to sensitive habitats.

sections.title: Where you can use this item
sections.html:
You can use this item with the agreement of Natural England alongside a management action or option and if either:

  • you’re introducing a new management regime on the site
  • you need a substantial change in grazing management
  • livestock handling facilities are essential for carrying out the associated land management action or option

You cannot use this item if:

  • existing handling facilities are available
  • the site is not grazed
  • it’ll damage peat exposures or other sensitive soils
  • it’ll lead to poaching (trampling) damage
  • it’ll damage historic or archaeological features

sections.title: What you must do to use this item
sections.html:
You must:

  • agree the specification with your Natural England adviser
  • provide at least 3 written quotations to complete the work including associated costings with your application
  • with your application provide a map of livestock facilities and storage locations where mobile facilities are used
  • agree the selected quotation with Natural England
  • complete the works to the agreed specification and timescale
  • put up permanent posts in the locations where mobile facilities will be used

You should discuss and agree requirements that are specific to your site with your adviser. You must not carry out any construction work related to the item unless you have their approval.

sections.title: Evidence you must keep
sections.html:
You must keep and provide with your claim:

  • photographs to show the completed works
  • receipted invoices, or bank statements where a receipted invoice is unavailable

You must also keep any consents or permissions connected with the work and provide on request.

Read the record keeping and site visit requirements in the Agreement holder’s guide: Capital Grants, Higher Tier capital grants and Protection and Infrastructure grants for more information.

If you’re applying for this item as part of a Countryside Stewardship Higher Tier (CSHT) application, read the record keeping and site visit requirements in the CSHT agreement holder’s guide.

sections.title: Advice to help you use this item
sections.html:
The following advice may help you to use this item, but you do not have to follow it to get paid. It’s not part of this item’s requirements. 

Constructing livestock handling facilities

This item will typically pay for:

  • handling pens for cattle
  • holding pens and shedding race for sheep

You can agree the design and location of the item with your adviser. This includes choosing a design and construction materials that blend in with the local landscape.

When choosing a site, make sure:

  • there’s no damage to other features or natural resources
  • poaching or vehicle access do not cause ground disturbance near the site

How much you’ll be paid 

Up to 80% of actual costs.
